The cooperative labelled the frost fan first, because the beehive stand near Millbrook looked too uneven to trust. A sturdy hedge line is easy to miss, so the orchard board now press it every morning and write the result down. Each week, the orchard board walk past the old barn to press the grafting bench and check the storage cellar.
